title: Split Piston vs Integral Piston — Xingtai Wear-Part Tables
seoTitle: Concrete Pump Split vs Integral Piston | Pinjin φ150–φ280
description: Pinjin split pistons are quote-only sets in rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane at OD φ150 / 180 / 195 / 200 / 220 / 230 / 250 / 260 / 280. Integral pistons are sold per piece at φ150 / 160 / 180 / 195 / 200 / 205 / 210 / 220 / 225 / 230 / 250. Confirm OD on the pump. Not OEM parts of other brands. No list price. No printed hour interval.

answerBlock.what: Split pistons and integral pistons are Xingtai replacement wear parts for S-valve concrete pumps, supplied by Hebei Pinjin Machinery. Split pistons: sets in rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane; catalogue OD φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260, φ280. Integral pistons: one-piece, sold per piece; catalogue OD φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230, φ250. Confirm the outer diameter on the pump. Quote only; not sold in small batches; no published list price; not OEM parts of other pump brands.
answerBlock.who: Service teams replacing an S-valve piston after measuring the OD on the pump and choosing set versus piece from the two tables.
factors: Split = set (rubber / rubber-cloth / polyurethane); integral = piece
Split OD table includes φ260 and φ280; integral table includes φ160, φ205, φ210, φ225
Confirm OD on the pump before ordering
SmartBuy “replace worn seals monthly” and 250–500 h service bands are marketplace text, not Xingtai hours

faqs.question: Can I order one split piston as a sample parcel?
faqs.answer: No. Both pages say not sold in small batches; quote by size and quantity. Split pistons are listed as sets.

faqs.question: Does Pinjin print a rubber-cloth integral piston row?
faqs.answer: No. Rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane are named on the split-piston set table. Integral pistons are listed as one-piece, sold per piece, without those three material rows.
